text: It is too expensive for me.
I understand. The 3 kW system is 1,95,000 rupees before the government subsidy of 78,000 rupees, so you pay 1,17,000 rupees. Would that help?
No, it is still too expensive for us.
We also have an EMI option from 2,999 rupees per month for 48 months. Would that make it easier for you?
Okay, what is the monthly EMI again?
The monthly EMI is 2,999 rupees for 48 months. Would that work for you?
Fine, book the free survey. My name is Kiran, I live in Velachery, Saturday works.
Your enquiry is saved, Kiran. The team will reach out to confirm the Saturday survey in Velachery.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
